goblinlabour.ring.hint1: Right-click: call a mining crew or send it home
goblinlabour.ring.expired: Time's up, the goblins go home.
goblinlabour.ring.no_room: No room for the goblins here.
goblinlabour.blank.name: Goblin: %s
goblinlabour.bed.empty: This bed is empty. Right-click it with a Goblin Blank.
goblinlabour.job.collect.tooltip: Pick up loose items within the radius and bring them to the goblin chests. Collectors carry a backpack: twice the storage.
goblinlabour.job.rest.tooltip: Stay home: wander about the flat and nap in bed. Heals.
goblinlabour.job.mine_down.tooltip: Dig a shaft straight down outside the home
goblinlabour.job.mine_ahead.tooltip: Dig a tunnel away from the home
goblinlabour.job.mine_up.tooltip: Dig a shaft straight up (staff order)
goblinlabour.job.chop.tooltip: Fell trees within the radius, pick up the logs, saplings, sticks and apples and replant saplings. Needs an axe for most logs.
goblinlabour.job.farm.tooltip: Works with the tools in its tool row. Hoe: harvest and replant crops, cocoa, berries, sugar cane, bamboo and cactus. Bucket: milk cows into a Milk Churn at home. Shears: shear sheep. Treetap: tap rubber trees.
goblinlabour.staff.hint2: Right-click floor, ceiling or wall to dig
goblinlabour.staff.select_first: Pick some goblins first (left-click them with the staff).
gui.goblinlabour.staff.size.tooltip: Footprint of the shaft: 1x1, 3x3 or 5x5 blocks around the clicked block.
gui.goblinlabour.staff.height.tooltip: Tunnel height. 1: only the clicked row. 2 or more: the floor is one block below the clicked block, so look straight ahead at the wall and click.
gui.goblinlabour.staff.target.tooltip: The shaft ends at this height (Y). Type a number or use the button next to it.
gui.goblinlabour.staff.bedrock.tooltip: Dig all the way down to bedrock.
gui.goblinlabour.staff.surface.tooltip: Dig up until the shaft reaches open sky.
gui.goblinlabour.staff.start.tooltip: Send every picked goblin to work on this order.
gui.goblinlabour.radius.tooltip: Work radius around the bed in blocks. Chop, Farm and Collect only look for trees, crops and items inside it.
gui.goblinlabour.width.tooltip: Tunnel width in blocks, centred on the clicked block.
gui.goblinlabour.length.tooltip: How far the tunnel goes into the wall. 16 blocks are one chunk.
gui.goblinlabour.stairs.tooltip: Build a cobblestone stair along the shaft wall so you can walk in and out.
gui.goblinlabour.replant.tooltip: Plant a sapling where a felled tree stood, from the saplings picked up under the tree. Saplings in the tool row are planted 3 to 6 blocks apart inside the radius. All else goes into the chests.
gui.goblinlabour.direction.tooltip: Which side of the home the work area lies on
gui.goblinlabour.churn_input.hint: A milk bucket is poured in, an empty bucket is filled. Both come out below.
gui.goblinlabour.tool_slot.hint: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe or sword; saplings for a lumberjack; bucket, shears, treetap or cocoa beans for a farmer. Tools never wear out here.
gui.goblinlabour.ring_book_slot.hint: Enchanted books: their enchantments go onto the crew's tools, e.g. Efficiency and Fortune.
gui.goblinlabour.backpack_slot.hint: Collectors carry twice as much loot.
gui.goblinlabour.backpack_slot.closed: Only collectors fill the backpack. Take out what is left.
goblinlabour.status.no_exit: no way out of the home
goblinlabour.handbook.basics.1: Goblins dig, chop, farm and collect for you. Each one lives in a straw bed, works from there and calls for help in chat.
goblinlabour.handbook.basics.2: Smelt or smoke the {Goblin Meat Pack} into a {Goblin Blank}.
goblinlabour.handbook.basics.3: Right-click the {Goblin Straw Bed} with a blank: a goblin moves in. Break the bed and it goes back into the blank, tools included.
goblinlabour.handbook.basics.5: Around every bed lies a home of 11 x 11 x 5 blocks. Goblins never dig there. Hold a {Goblin Head} to see its borders.
goblinlabour.handbook.basics.7: Goblins unload into the {Goblin Chests} of their home. No room left: they lie down and complain.
goblinlabour.handbook.basics.9: Right-click a goblin for its inventory. Tools go in the top row and never wear out.
goblinlabour.handbook.basics.10: Goblins place free torches and plug lava and water with cobblestone.
goblinlabour.handbook.basics.11: {Goblin Scaffold} takes them up to high logs and out of pits. It vanishes by itself.
goblinlabour.handbook.basics.12: Lava, drowning and falls kill goblins.
goblinlabour.handbook.basics.13: A dead goblin respawns at its bed with its tools. Its loot drops where it died, and it walks back for it.
goblinlabour.handbook.jobs.1: Right-click a bed to pick a job and the radius around the bed.
goblinlabour.handbook.jobs.3: {Chop}: fells one tree at a time, from the lowest log up, and replants. Hacks through leaves, climbs scaffold.
goblinlabour.handbook.jobs.4: Saplings in its tool row are planted out, 3 to 6 blocks apart.
goblinlabour.handbook.jobs.5: {Farm}: works with the tools in its tool row, see Farming.
goblinlabour.handbook.jobs.6: {Collect}: picks up loose items and carries twice as much.
goblinlabour.handbook.jobs.7: Everything they bring home goes into the goblin chests.
goblinlabour.handbook.staff.1: Left-click goblins with the {Goblin Staff} to pick them. They glow and follow you.
goblinlabour.handbook.staff.2: Right-click a block: floor = dig down, ceiling = dig up, wall = tunnel.
goblinlabour.handbook.staff.3: Sneak + right-click opens the settings first.
goblinlabour.handbook.staff.5: Defaults: a 3 x 3 shaft with stairs, down to bedrock or up to the surface. Tunnels are 3 x 3 and 32 long.
goblinlabour.handbook.staff.6: Tunnels 2 or more high start one block below the click. Height 1 digs that row only.
goblinlabour.handbook.staff.7: Picked goblins share one order and go back to their job when it is done.
goblinlabour.handbook.ring.1: Right-click the {Goblin Ring}: three goblins mine ores within 8 blocks for 5 minutes and pick up items (yours after 3 seconds).
goblinlabour.handbook.ring.2: A vein is mined out completely, hidden ores too.
goblinlabour.handbook.ring.3: Dig stone or earth yourself: they help, never below your feet.
goblinlabour.handbook.ring.4: Picked with the staff they follow you. A staff order takes them off the leash until it is done.
goblinlabour.handbook.ring.5: Sneak + right-click opens the ring. {Enchanted books} in its two slots enchant the crew's tools.
goblinlabour.handbook.ring.6: A goblin chest within 16 blocks: one goblin carries the loot over.
goblinlabour.handbook.farming.1: A farmer does whatever its tool row has tools for, the nearest thing first. Tools never wear out.
goblinlabour.handbook.farming.2: {Hoe}: harvests and replants crops, cocoa, sweet and glow berries, sugar cane, bamboo and cactus.
goblinlabour.handbook.farming.3: Without a hoe ripe crops stay, and the farmer asks for one.
goblinlabour.handbook.farming.4: {Cocoa beans} in the tool row are planted on jungle logs.
goblinlabour.handbook.farming.5: {Bucket}: milks cows, each one every 5 minutes.
goblinlabour.handbook.farming.6: The milk goes into a {Milk Churn} at home and shows behind its glass. Right-click it with a bucket, or with an empty hand for its screen. Broken, it keeps its milk.
goblinlabour.handbook.farming.8: {Treetap} (Tech Reborn): taps rubber trees for sap.
